archetypes.name: dyn-analyze-bugs
archetypes.rationale: Report verdict precedence changed for analyze-bugs deep results.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the analyze-bugs report verdict precedence around mechanical NEEDS_DEEP versus ledger deep verdicts. Check that terminal mechanical verdicts still override stale ledger data, while deep verdicts now drive counts, issue rows, and follow-up eligibility for deep-routed bugs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
